name: MVGS_CS_GENETIC_DIAGNOSTIC_ASSESSMENT
title: MV-GenomSeq evaluation of genetic diagnostics (hereditary tumour cases)
description: KDK oncology diagnosisOd.diagnosticAssessment (evaluation of genetic diagnostics, hereditary-tumour cases only). No MII Onko/MTB concept exists (DISCUSS-TD #5, REPRESENTATIONS #5): the converter emits an Observation whose code is `genetic-diagnostic-assessment` and whose value is one of the five assessment codes (codes = KDK enum values, 1:1).

concept.definition: Observation code: overall evaluation of the genetic diagnostics performed for a (suspected) hereditary tumour syndrome (KDK diagnosisOd.diagnosticAssessment). Not an answer value.
Genetic diagnostics did not establish a genetic diagnosis.
A genetic diagnosis is suspected but not confirmed.
A genetic diagnosis explains the findings only partially.
